grade: maximum absolute realization origin of the selected retained packets
sameOriginClosure: Explore every compatible configuration and labelled zero-grade revisit; never force all NE branches before positive NN alternatives.
branchDepth: Sibling +1 operations both land at r+1; grades combine by maximum, not sum.
contexts: Bind and validate full native contexts even at the maximum origin. Final C index, lookahead context indices and reader visits are separate optional policies, not extra origin advances.
exitCertificate: All occupied face contacts have local transport witnesses and every selected retained packet reaches an E. Unselected globally cached alternatives impose no obligation.
globalSewing: Not inferred from local contacts. Audit explicitly asserted occurrence/full-map identifications on all five real and imaginary coordinate basis inputs. Otherwise retain distinct records. Return input-subspace restrictions or require an ancestry-enriched key when applicable.
historyRepresentation: Finite packet/configuration graphs encode potentially infinite ordered revisit words. No history quotient, phase reset or secondary word bound is used for phase completeness.
largerNumbers: 8/10 advances means D=8/10; 8/10 layers including seed means D=7/9. The displayed8/10-visit examples have origins1/2 only; do not choose their general meaning without operator confirmation.
